1.mascotDialogue: Two ends this time, beta, not one — front for leaving, back for joining, that's it. Mix those up even once and you've quietly built yourself a stack instead!

2.mascotDialogue: That `% MAX` on both front and rear, beta — that is what lets this array wrap around instead of shifting everybody forward every single time someone leaves. Smart, no?

3.mascotDialogue: FRONT and REAR — two separate markers now, beta. Watch them, they stay two apart, no matter how much you enqueue or dequeue.

4.mascotDialogue: An empty queue is not 'nothing to see,' beta — it is a specific, checkable state! If your dequeue does not check for it, it will happily hand you garbage and call it a real value. Not okay!
